name: Aven
overview: The term 'Aven' in Scripture is associated with locations of significant judgment and idolatry. It is identified as 'the plain of the Sun' and another name for On, also referred to as Heliopolis, a city condemned for its sinfulness and destined for destruction (Ezekiel 30:17; Amos 1:5). The high places of Aven symbolize Israel's spiritual unfaithfulness, where altars to false gods will be overthrown, illustrating God's righteous judgment against idolatry (Hosea 10:8). Additionally, Beth-Aven is linked to this theme of apostasy and divine discipline.
